summary: Tilt to fly a pixel jet over islands in overhead, chase and cockpit views.
description: Fly mirui’s Pixel Flight on the built-in display. Bank and climb with the BMI270 or use the keyboard. Switch between three cameras, change your formation and fly from day into night to a looping 8-bit soundtrack.
